Record Class CurrentModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.copilot.generated.rpc.CurrentModel
@Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public record CurrentModel(String modelId, String providerId, String planBaseModelId, String planBaseProviderId, String reasoningEffort, ContextTier contextTier, AutoTier autoTier, AutoTier pendingAutoTier, AutoTier activatingAutoTier) extends Record
The session's authoritative model snapshot. Auto preference fields are configuration for the virtual `auto` model and do not change the selected model identifier. The context tier reflects `Session.getContextTier()`, restored from the session journal on resume.
